title: Admin screens
steps: Admin opens /admin/users: search + status filter, lock Minh via the confirm dialog, try to remove the last admin; lock the only user on page 2 of the active list; opens /admin/categories: add (first with a 41-character keyword), edit, delete a template, switch to the income tab
expected: Stats shown; filters sent on submit only; PATCH {status:'locked'} only after confirming; LAST_ADMIN shown translated; the emptied page 2 goes back to page 1; the long keyword is blocked in the browser with a translated message and nothing is sent; POST/PATCH/DELETE bodies correct; no delete button on the fallback
proves: The admin UI drives the admin API correctly and asks before destructive actions

title: Transactions screen: list, URL-synced filters, add/edit dialog, delete with Undo
steps: Open /transactions and /transactions?type=income; change wallet and search filters; clear them; add with amount '45k' and a chosen date-time; edit the amount to '50k'; delete a row and press Undo with the keyboard; open ?page=2 when the server says total 3
expected: Rows show category, wallet and a signed amount (−/+), drafts marked 'Nháp'; filters are read from and written to the query string, search waits for a typing pause; the dialog validates and focuses the first wrong field, sends amount 45000 and occurredAt with +07:00; PATCH amount 50000; DELETE then POST /restore brings the row back, focus moves to Undo when it appears and to the page heading after it; a page past the last one is replaced by the last page (?page=1)
proves: Customers can browse, filter and correct their history on the web, and a delete can be undone

title: Amount field shortcuts and Vietnam time in the form
steps: parseAmount on '45k', '1,5tr', '1tr5', '150.000', '0', '-5', '12.5', 'abc', a 19-digit number; datetime-local conversion of 2026-11-30T17:10Z
expected: 45000, 1500000, 1500000, 150000, then null for each invalid one; the form shows 2026-12-01T00:10 and sends 2026-12-01T00:10:00+07:00
proves: The web form accepts the same k/tr shortcuts as the bot and never shifts dates by the browser's time zone

title: Quick add: debounced preview, Enter, errors, several lines, chip edit, Shift+Enter
steps: Type 'phở 45k' and wait; press Enter; type 'abc' + Enter; paste 3 lines + Enter; change a preview chip's wallet then Enter; type 'cafe 30k' + Shift+Enter and save the form; with a slow parse, type 'phở 45k' then Enter, Enter and click Lưu; preview 'cafe 30k mm' then invalidate wallets
expected: One parse call after the pause (none per key) and preview chips (amount, category, wallet, date); Enter POSTs the draft and clears the box; 'abc' shows NO_AMOUNT_FOUND inline in Vietnamese with aria-invalid and saves nothing; 3 lines → 3 POSTs in order; the chip edit changes the saved walletId; Shift+Enter opens the full form pre-filled with the parsed draft; presses during a running parse are ignored, so exactly 1 POST; a wallet/category change re-parses the same text so no stale ids are saved
proves: The quick-add box behaves as docs/05 §5.7 describes, with nothing saved by the preview

title: Link card: code, countdown, app button + QR, /link command, expiry, unlink
steps: Open /bot with one linked Telegram account; Generate code; unlink the account; open /bot with GET /chat-links failing once, press Retry; with a code that expires in 1 s and no bot username, Generate, wait, then Create a new code against a 429; then, with the POST and the next GET /chat-links held, click Generate once, answer the POST; and a code request answering 500, then switch to English
expected: The card titled 'Liên kết Telegram / WhatsApp / Zalo' names all three apps in its description; the code, 'Hết hạn sau 10:00', 'Mở WhatsApp' (Telegram is linked already) → the wa.me link, a QR image and '/link CODE'; focus moves to the code; unlink asks first, sends DELETE /chat-links/:id, the list shows 'none linked' and focus is on its heading; a failed list load shows a translated error with Retry; no app button, picker or QR when every links entry is null (the /link CODE command still shows); the expired code is replaced by 'expired' + a new-code button; 429 shows RATE_LIMITED in Vietnamese; Generate is disabled while the POST is held; the code shows while the list is still held, with no Generate button left, and one POST /chat-links/code has been sent; the 500 message turns into 'The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.' after the switch
proves: Linking from the web works as docs/05 §5.7 describes, including the expiry and the rate limit

title: QR encoder output
steps: qrMatrix('HELLO'); reedSolomon on the ISO 18004 example; qrMatrix of a deep link, a 32-character bot name link, and 107 characters
expected: The exact 21×21 symbol of the reference qrcode package (byte mode, level L, mask 0); EC codewords 165 36 212 193 237 54 199 135 44 85; a 29×29 symbol; at most 37×37; an error
proves: The QR code on the Bot inbox is a valid, scannable symbol without a QR library

title: Link the real Telegram and Zalo chats
steps: bot-e2e TG-01, TG-09, ZL-01 (docs/testing/bot-e2e.md): /start CODE in Telegram Web, /link CODE in Zalo Web, then a second code
expected: 'Đã liên kết với tài khoản …' in both chats; GET /chat-links lists telegram and zalo; a linked chat refuses a second code
proves: Linking works through the real chat apps, not only with recorded payloads

title: Drafts list: sources, inline edit, receipt items, confirm, discard
steps: Open /bot with a Telegram, a Zalo and a receipt draft; clear the amount of 'phở' and Confirm; type 50k and Confirm; expand the receipt items; Confirm the unchanged Zalo draft (budget at 85 %); Discard the receipt draft
expected: Each card shows its source; an empty amount is marked aria-invalid, focused, and nothing is sent; then PATCH {amount: 50000} before POST /confirm and the card leaves the list; the receipt shows '2 dòng hàng · khớp tổng tiền' and its lines; the unchanged draft sends only POST /confirm and the budget warning shows; Discard asks first, then DELETE; after each Confirm or Discard focus is on the drafts heading, not <body>
proves: Drafts from chat can be corrected inline and only the needed requests are sent

title: Opening the inbox again refetches drafts
steps: Open /bot (3 drafts); leave; the server confirms one (as 'ok' in a chat does); open /bot again in the app
expected: Bản nháp chờ duyệt (2); the confirmed draft is gone without a reload
proves: Drafts changed in the chats never linger in the web inbox (regression test for BUG-004)

title: Upload: resized image sent as field 'image', status while reading, errors translated
steps: Choose a photo (resize mocked) with a slow /api/receipts; let it answer 201; upload again against 422 RECEIPT_UNREADABLE; choose a PDF that cannot be opened as an image
expected: The resized JPEG (not the original) is POSTed as multipart field 'image'; a polite status 'Đang đọc hoá đơn…' and a disabled button while waiting; then 'Đã tạo bản nháp…' and the new draft in the list; RECEIPT_UNREADABLE and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE in Vietnamese; the PDF is never sent
proves: The web upload shows progress for the 20–40 s KIE read and explains every failure

title: Budgets screen: bars with text labels, add/edit/delete, copy from last month
steps: Open /budgets with budgets at 50 %, 80 %, 90 % and 120 % (overall); add with an empty limit, then '300k' for the only free category; edit a limit to '1tr5'; delete a budget; go to the next (empty) month, add an overall budget '2tr' and click Copy from last month
expected: Overall budget first; each card has a native progress bar named by its category (value capped at the limit), 'Đã chi … / … (n%)' and a level word: 'Trong hạn mức' below 80 %, 'Sắp hết' from 80 % to 100 %, 'Vượt ngân sách' above, plus 'Còn …' or 'Vượt …'; the add dialog offers only categories without a budget, an empty limit shows a translated error on the focused field and sends nothing; POST {month, categoryId, limit:300000}; edit hides the category and sends PATCH {limit:1500000}; DELETE only after the confirm dialog; the empty month shows its empty state, POST {categoryId:null, limit:2000000}, then POST /budgets/copy {from: this month, to: next month} and 'Đã chép ngân sách: 3'
proves: The budgets screen drives the docs/04 budgets API and shows usage with colour and text, never colour alone

title: Dashboard: month cards, chart summaries, drafts banner, latest 5, month switch, error
steps: Open / with stats for this month, 2 drafts and 7 confirmed transactions; click Previous month (no data, no overall budget); make /stats/summary fail, then click Retry
expected: h1 greets the user; cards show income, expense, net and budget left with 'Hạn mức …'; the pie figure lists 'Category: amount (n%)' for each slice and the daily figure says the totals and the biggest spending day; 'Có 2 giao dịch nháp…' links to /bot; 5 latest transactions with signed amounts and a link to /transactions; after the month switch the cards show 0 ₫, 'Chưa đặt ngân sách tổng' links to /budgets and both figures say the month is empty; a failed request shows the translated error and Retry loads the cards
proves: The dashboard reads the docs/04 stats API for the month in the shared MonthPicker and gives every chart a text alternative

title: Settings screen: profile, password form, device names
steps: Open /settings as Lan (default wallet Tiền mặt); clear the name and Save; type '  Lan Anh ', pick Momo and Save; open the account menu. In Đổi mật khẩu submit empty, then a wrong current password with mismatched new ones, then matching ones, then the right current password. Name devices from Chrome/Windows, Safari/iPhone, Chrome/Android, Edge/macOS, Firefox/Linux and curl user agents
expected: Empty name keeps focus with 'Họ tên từ 1 đến 60 ký tự' and sends nothing; then PATCH /users/me {name:'Lan Anh', defaultWalletId:'w2'}, 'Đã lưu hồ sơ' and the account menu shows Lan Anh without a new login. Password: field errors with focus on the first wrong field, nothing sent until valid; 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS shows 'Mật khẩu hiện tại không đúng' on that field; success clears the form, says other devices were logged out and the device list refetches; inputs use autocomplete current-password / new-password. Devices: 'Chrome · Windows', 'Safari · iOS', 'Chrome · Android', 'Edge · macOS', 'Firefox · Linux', unknown → 'Thiết bị không rõ'
proves: The Settings page drives PATCH /users/me and /users/me/password with the API's rules, translated errors and accessible focus handling, and AuthContext shows the saved profile at once

title: A refresh whose answer was lost does not log out every device
steps: Second device logged in; refresh A → B (answer lost); refresh A again within 30 s; use the new token C; refresh on the second device; present A a third time
expected: 200 with a new token C; unused B revoked; C and the second device keep working; the third A (its replacement C was used) → 401 and every session revoked
proves: Lost refresh answers are forgiven once, real reuse is still caught (regression test for BUG-003)

title: Hermetic E2E server: bot calls stubbed, other external hosts blocked
steps: With server/test/helpers/bot-api-stub.js active, send a message through the production Telegram and Zalo adapters, fetch https://example.com and a Zalo photo URL, fetch 127.0.0.1 and localhost; start test/helpers/e2e-server.js with real-looking bot tokens and POST an unlinked Telegram update and Zalo event to the webhooks
expected: Bot API calls answer {ok:true, result:{message_id, chat, …}} and are recorded as {platform, method, chatId} without the token; other hosts fail with a network error and a '[bot-api-stub] blocked outbound request to <host>' log line; local hosts pass through; the E2E server logs '[bot-api-stub] telegram|zalo sendMessage chat=<id>' for both replies, no 'webhook update failed' and never a token
proves: BUG-002 is fixed: the Playwright suite can never message a real Telegram or Zalo chat, and a new outbound call cannot slip in unnoticed

title: Category breakdown: each row keeps its category colour, no two rows share one
steps: sliceColors() for 9 rows: two categories with their own colours, a third repeating one of them, six with none; and a category whose colour equals the first fallback
expected: Own colours kept (lower-cased); the repeated colour and the colourless rows get fallback colours; all 9 colours distinct; a fallback already taken by a category is skipped
proves: The dashboard's category breakdown never marks two categories with the same colour (bug seen in the 2026-11-20 captures: 6 rank colours for 8 categories), and a row matches its category colour elsewhere in the app

title: UI fonts are self-hosted and draw Vietnamese text
steps: Open /login in vi; read the h1's computed font-family; document.fonts.load('300 32px "Be Vietnam Pro"', 'Sổ chi tiêu ữ'); record every request to another host
expected: h1 font-family starts with "Be Vietnam Pro"; the loaded faces are all 'loaded' and include the Vietnamese subset (U+1EA0-1EF9); no request leaves the app's host
proves: Vietnamese headings render in the design font (no mixed fallback glyphs) and the redesign added no third-party font CDN

title: Weekly comparison: days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–end, against the previous month
steps: weekTotals() over days 1,7,8,14,15,21,22,30,31 for expense and income; previousMonth('2026-11'), previousMonth('2026-01'); dashboard unit test (clock fixed to the 25th) switches the chart to Thu nhập; the Playwright dashboard test reads the same sentence
expected: [150,15,8,12] and [0,3,0,9]; day 31 in week 4; '2026-10' and '2025-12'; the figure's sentence names this month's total, the difference against the same days last month ('cùng kỳ tháng trước') and the highest week
proves: The dashboard's weekly column chart (draft 3, T18) buckets every day of any month into the right week and compares it with the correct calendar month, also across a year boundary; its sentence compares the same days (T43)

title: bot-e2e.mjs: --help prints the usage; a bad option is one line, not a stack trace
steps: node --test tools/bot-e2e/bot-e2e.test.mjs: run the CLI with --help, with -h, with `list --targt staging` (unknown option) and with `state --target` (option without its value)
expected: --help and -h exit 0 with the usage on stdout and nothing on stderr; both bad options exit 1 with exactly one line on stderr naming the problem, no stack trace and no ERR_PARSE_ARGS code; the unknown option also prints the usage
proves: The real-chat checker's own command line fails like a tool, not like a crash: a typo in an option tells the operator what is wrong and how to call it, and nothing reaches the network (regression test for BUG-007)

title: Revoke-all wins against a rotation running at the same moment
steps: Second device logged in; refresh A → B; pause Session.create inside a parallel rotation (a second grace retry of A, or a refresh of B) right after it claimed its old session; while paused, present A again (theft: revoke all); let the rotation finish. Also: A → B → C, stamp sessionsRevokedAt between A's login and C's creation, refresh C. Also: an admin lock + revoke-all while a refresh is paused the same way
expected: The theft answers 401; the paused rotation answers 401 INVALID_REFRESH; refreshing C answers 401; the locked case answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED; in every case no session of the user stays active
proves: "Every session revoked" really leaves none: a refresh between its claim and its new session, or a session created while the revoke-all was being written, cannot keep a chain that began before the revoke-all alive (regression test for BUG-006)

title: Passwords longer than 72 bytes are refused
steps: POST /auth/register with 'ư'×36 + 'a1b2c3d4e5f6' (48 characters, 84 bytes); register with 'ư'×36 (exactly 72 bytes); PATCH /users/me/password with the 84-byte password as newPassword. In Settings → Đổi mật khẩu, enter the 84-byte password as the new one
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details [{path:'password'}] and no user stored; 201 for 72 bytes; 400 with details [{path:'newPassword'}]; the form marks Mật khẩu mới 'Mật khẩu quá dài…', focuses it and sends nothing
proves: bcrypt never silently drops the tail of a password: a different password sharing the first 72 bytes can no longer log in or change the password (regression test for BUG-009)

title: Logging out one or the other devices wins against a refresh on that device
steps: Devices A and B logged in; pause Session.create inside B's refresh right after it claimed its old session; while paused, A sends DELETE /sessions?others=true, or PATCH /users/me/password, or DELETE /sessions/<B's id>, or B sends POST /auth/logout; let the rotation finish; refresh A. Also: B rotates after A loaded the list, A deletes B's old id, then deletes it again
expected: The revoke answers 204; B's rotation answers 401 INVALID_REFRESH; only A's session stays active and A still refreshes; the out-of-date id still logs B out (204, B's new token 401), and a second delete is 404
proves: Every revoke that keeps this device or ends one device (log out others, password change, Settings logout, logout) leaves the revoked device logged out even when its refresh runs at the same moment (regression test for BUG-010)

title: Refresh after an admin lock answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED and the login page says so
steps: Devices A (rotated A → B) and a second device; lock the user and revoke all sessions as PATCH /admin/users/:id does; refresh with A, B and the second device's token, then with an unknown token. In the browser: the refresh answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED while the app starts at /
expected: 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED for all three tokens (no theft handling), 401 INVALID_REFRESH for the unknown one; the app shows the login page with 'Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khoá…'
proves: docs/04 §4.3 'Login and refresh return 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED' holds after a real admin lock, and a locked user learns why they were logged out (regression test for BUG-011)

title: Register form rejects what the API rejects, on the right field
steps: Open /register; submit with each e-mail nguyễn-1@example.com, a@b.c, a..b@example.com, a@example.com., user@exämple.com, x@example.co1; then a valid e-mail with a 73-character password and with a 48-character Vietnamese one; then let the API answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR details [{path:'email'}] to a valid form
expected: The password hint states the 72 limit; each e-mail is marked 'Email không hợp lệ'; both passwords are marked 'Mật khẩu quá dài…' and nothing is sent; the API answer shows the alert and also marks the Email field (aria-invalid, its message, focus)
proves: The register page's checks match the server's zod rules and a server-side field error is shown on its field (regression test for BUG-012)

title: Confirm with edits applies them to a draft only
steps: Insert a Telegram draft (40.000); POST /api/transactions/:id/confirm with {amount:12.5}, then {type:'income'}, then {amount:45000, note}. Insert another draft, confirm it without a body (as ✅ in the chat does), then confirm it again with {amount:99000, type:'income', categoryId: Lương}
expected: 400, 400, then 200 with status confirmed, amount 45000 and the trimmed note; the late confirm answers 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED and the saved transaction keeps amount 40000, type expense; the wallet balance counts 45000 + 40000
proves: The inbox's edits and the confirm are one write guarded by status draft, so a 409 changes nothing (regression test for BUG-008)

title: A stale inbox card cannot rewrite a transaction confirmed in the chat
steps: Open /bot; the server confirms draft 'phở' (45.000) as ✅ in the chat does; on the still-open card change the amount to 99k and press Xác nhận
expected: Exactly one request, POST /transactions/d1/confirm carrying the edits (no PATCH); 'Giao dịch này đã được xác nhận.' is shown, the card leaves the list, and the transaction keeps amount 45000
proves: The web sends edits only through the draft-only confirm, so a refusal never leaves a silent edit behind (regression test for BUG-008)

title: Archiving the default wallet clears the default
steps: Register (default 'Tiền mặt'); add 'MoMo'; PATCH /api/wallets/<default> {archived:true}; GET /api/auth/me; POST /api/transactions/parse 'phở 45k'. Then set users.defaultWalletId back to the archived wallet in the database and parse again
expected: /auth/me defaultWalletId null; both parses return walletId = MoMo (the archived default is ignored even when still stored)
proves: An archived wallet is never chosen for new money by quick add or the bots, and Settings agrees with the server (regression test for BUG-016)

title: Archiving the default wallet updates the signed-in user
steps: Log in as a user whose default wallet is 'Tiền mặt'; open /wallets and archive 'Tiền mặt'
expected: The session's user now has defaultWalletId null, without a reload
proves: The Add form and Settings stop preselecting an archived wallet in the same session (regression test for BUG-016)

title: Parse names the lines it cannot save
steps:
POST /api/transactions/parse 'phở 45k

cafe không tiền
grab 30k'; then 11 lines with amounts
expected: 200 with 2 drafts, noAmountLines [3] (line numbers as typed), truncated false; 11 lines → 10 drafts, noAmountLines [], truncated true
proves: The caller learns about every line that will not become a transaction (regression test for BUG-017)

title: Quick add refuses to drop lines
steps: Paste 'phở 45k / cafe không tiền / grab 30k' and wait; press Enter. Clear, paste 11 lines with amounts and wait; press Enter
expected: The hint says 'Dòng 2 không có số tiền…'; Enter marks the box invalid, saves nothing and keeps the text. With 11 lines the hint says 'Mỗi lần chỉ lưu được 10 dòng…' and Enter saves nothing
proves: Nothing the user typed is thrown away silently; the box is only cleared after every line was saved (regression test for BUG-017)

title: One money value is at most 10^13 ₫
steps: POST/PATCH a transaction amount, POST a budget limit and a wallet initialBalance of 10^13 + 1 and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (±10^13 + 1 for the balance); then exactly 10^13 (−10^13 for a credit wallet); create a Transaction model with 10^13 + 1 directly
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for every value above the ceiling; 201 at the ceiling; the model rejects amount 10^13 + 1
proves: Wallet balances and month totals, summed as doubles, stay exact safe integers (regression test for BUG-018)

title: Every line is saved even when the bot's reply fails
steps: Zalo sendMessage answers ok:false; send 'cafe 21k\nbánh mì 22k\ntaxi 23k'
expected: 3 drafts (21.000, 22.000, 23.000); pendingTransactionId is the last one; the failure is logged once
proves: A failed reply (quota, 429, timeout) never loses the lines after it, since the platform never resends (regression test for BUG-026)

title: Zalo amount-only reply corrects the pending draft
steps: Zalo 'grab 32k' → '55k' → 'ok'; then '40k' with nothing pending
expected: One draft, now 55.000 with note 'grab' and its category, re-sent with the hint and still pending; 'ok' confirms it; '40k' alone later is a new draft
proves: docs/02 §2.4 'Reply with a corrected line (e.g. 55k)' edits the draft instead of making a second one (regression test for BUG-027)

title: Zalo ok/huy reach every draft of a multi-line message
steps: Zalo 'an sang 30k\ntra sua 40k' → 'ok' → 'huy' → 'ok'
expected: 'ok' saves 40.000 and names the 30.000 draft as next; 'huy' discards 30.000; only then 'nothing pending'
proves: No draft the bot asked to confirm is left unreachable from Zalo (regression test for BUG-028)

title: /month shows category budget usage
steps: Food budget 150.000 with 135.000 spent, Transport 320.000 with 64.000, no overall budget; send /month
expected: Lines 'Ngân sách "Ăn uống": 90% (135.000 ₫ / 150.000 ₫)' then Transport 20%, fullest first; no overall line; GET /stats/summary budget stays null
proves: /month gives 'month total and budget usage' (docs/02) for category budgets too, without changing the summary API (regression test for BUG-029)

title: After a logout the next user starts at /
steps: Lan opens /transactions?walletId=w1 → account menu → Đăng xuất; Minh logs in on the same browser
expected: URL is / with no query; Dashboard says 'Xin chào, Minh'
proves: An explicit logout does not save the previous user's page and filters as the next login's destination; only a deep link opened while logged out is restored (regression test for BUG-013)

title: A login that overlaps a password change or an admin lock leaves no working session
steps: Pause bcrypt.compare inside POST /auth/login (the old password was read, not yet checked); while paused, device A sends PATCH /users/me/password (204), or the user is locked and every session revoked as PATCH /admin/users/:id does; let the login finish. Then log in with the old password, and with the new one. Also: while paused, A sends DELETE /sessions?others=true
expected: The login answers 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS after the password change, 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED after the lock, with no rt cookie and no active session from that login; device A stays signed in and refreshes (200); a later login with the old password is 401 and with the new one works; the login that overlaps 'log out other devices' answers 200 and its session refreshes
proves: A password change or a lock signs out every session, including a login that was still checking the old password: login re-reads the user after opening its session and revokes it when the password hash changed or the account is locked, without rejecting a login whose password is still valid (regression test for BUG-040)

title: Failed preference save says the choice lasts only until a reload
steps: PATCH /users/me fails; click the dark-theme toggle; re-mount the app (reload)
expected: Warning 'Không lưu được lựa chọn vào tài khoản. Lựa chọn chỉ có hiệu lực đến khi tải lại trang – vui lòng thử lại.'; dark applies now; after the reload the profile theme is back
proves: The warning matches docs/05 §5.6 (profile wins at start-up) instead of promising the choice stays on the device (regression test for BUG-014)

title: App bar and drawer avatars show the same initials
steps: Render UserMenu and NavDrawer for the user 'Nguyễn Văn An'
expected: Both avatars show 'VA'
proves: One shared initials helper: one user, one avatar on the same screen (regression test for BUG-025)

title: Admin users list recovers from a failed load
steps: First GET /admin/users answers 500 → press Thử lại; later one more 500 after Tìm with the same search → press Tìm again
expected: Error alert with a Retry button and no 'Đang tải…' or stale rows; Retry and a repeated Tìm both send the request and show the list
proves: A failed admin list can be loaded again without reloading the page (regression test for BUG-015)

title: Long linked-chat name with no spaces wraps inside the card
steps: GET /chat-links returns a Telegram link whose displayName is 64 characters with no spaces; open /bot
expected: The name element has overflow-wrap: anywhere; in the browser (e2e/bot.spec.ts) the 'Đã liên kết ✓' message in the link card wraps the same name: its scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 360, 375, 390 and 1280 px
proves: A long chat name breaks inside the Linked accounts card instead of making /bot scroll sideways (TC-NF-02) (regression test for BUG-030)

title: Receipt status and error follow a language switch
steps: Upload succeeds, then POST /receipts answers 502 KIE_UNAVAILABLE; press EN; upload again; press VI
expected: The alert becomes 'The receipt reader is unavailable…'; the done line switches EN ↔ VI with the page
proves: Upload status and errors are kept as keys/codes and translated when shown (docs/02 §2.7) (regression test for BUG-031)

title: Dashboard budget-left bar uses the Budgets page's thresholds
expected: Bar colour warning at 84 %, error at 100.4 %, primary just under 80 %
proves: The dashboard and the Budgets page share one exact-amount rule (amber from 80 %, red above 100 %), not a rounded 85 % (regression test for BUG-019)

title: Dashboard shows category budgets past 80 % and 100 %
steps: Budgets Ăn uống 2.500.000 with 2.145.000 spent, Đi lại 300.000 with 330.000, overall 10.000.000 with 2.475.000; open /
expected: A 'Ngân sách cần chú ý' status lists 'Ăn uống: Sắp hết · Đã chi 2.145.000 ₫ / 2.500.000 ₫ (86%)' and 'Đi lại: Vượt ngân sách · Vượt 30.000 ₫', not the overall budget, with a 'Xem ngân sách' link to /budgets
proves: The web side of the budget alert: the dashboard shows a category past 80 % or 100 % (regression test for BUG-020)

title: Dashboard error state for wallets and recent transactions
steps: GET /api/wallets answers 500, then Retry with it working; separately GET /api/transactions?status=confirmed answers 500
expected: The translated load error with Retry appears and no total-balance card (no '0 ₫'); after Retry the card shows the real balance; a failed recent-transactions request shows the same error
proves: A failed request never reads as a real 0 ₫ balance or an empty list (regression test for BUG-022)

title: English singular for a count of 1
steps: English account with 1 draft; open /; translate transactions:total with count 1 and 2
expected: '1 draft transaction is waiting for confirmation.'; 'Total: 1 transaction' and 'Total: 2 transactions'; Vietnamese unchanged
proves: Counted English strings use i18next _one/_other plurals (regression test for BUG-024)

title: Money amounts never wrap at phone width
steps: Account with a 1.234.567.890 ₫ expense and an overall budget; open / at 375×812 in vi, then in en
expected: Each figure card's amount has one line box (getClientRects().length = 1), including -1.234.567.890 ₫ and -₫1,234,567,890; no sideways scroll
proves: An amount is never split inside the number or after its minus sign (regression test for BUG-021)

title: The dashboard chart adds no keyboard stops
steps: At 1280 px focus the Thu nhập switch of the month comparison and press Tab once
expected: 'Xem tất cả' has focus: no stop on the chart's svg or its Recharts layers
proves: Every Tab stop has a name and a visible focus ring; the chart's text summary stands in for it (regression test for BUG-023)

title: Amount fields say the 10^13 ₫ maximum
steps: parseAmount / isOverMax on 10000000000000, 10000000tr, 10000000000001, 10000001tr, 9007199254740991; type 10000000000001 in the Add transaction amount, 10000001tr in a budget limit and -10000000000001 in a wallet's opening balance, then Save
expected: 10^13 is read, anything above is null and over the maximum; each field is marked 'Tối đa 10.000.000.000.000 ₫' (wallet: 'Từ -10.000.000.000.000 ₫ đến 10.000.000.000.000 ₫'), gets focus, and no request is sent
proves: The web forms check the API's money ceiling before sending and say why next to the field (regression test for BUG-032)

title: An amount over 10^13 ₫ is not an amount for the parser or the bot
expected: 10^13 is read, the others are null; the bot makes one 45.000 ₫ draft, replies 'Chưa ghi dòng 1: không đọc được số tiền (tối đa 10.000.000.000.000 ₫)…', logs no error; the over-cap line alone gets the help text
proves: A line the API would refuse is treated like a line with no amount, so it never makes the whole message fail (regression test for BUG-033)

title: A year or month typed before the amount is a date, not the amount
steps: parseLine on 'thuê nhà năm 2026 36tr', 'học phí năm 2025 12.000.000', 'bảo hiểm năm 2026 1500000', 'ăn tối tháng 10 50' (accented and unaccented); the controls 'thuê nhà 36tr năm 2026', 'tiền nhà tháng 11 5tr', 'ăn tối tháng 10 50k', 'cắt tóc nam 50k', 'cắt tóc nam 50000', 'áo nam 2000k', 'gửi xe tháng 100k', 'ăn tối tháng 10k', 'thuê nhà năm 2.026'; the date-only lines 'tiền nhà tháng 10' and 'năm 2025'; send the first four lines plus 'tiền nhà tháng 10' to the Telegram bot and to POST /api/transactions/parse, then 'năm 2025' alone to both
expected: The amounts are 36.000.000, 12.000.000, 1.500.000 and 50.000 and the year or month stays in the note; the controls keep their amounts (a unit or separators make the number money; 1900-2099 and 1-12 are the only dates); a date-only line is null, so the bot makes no draft for it and names the line number, the parse endpoint lists it in noAmountLines, and a message with only that line gets the help text / 422 NO_AMOUNT_FOUND
proves: A year or month never becomes the amount of a real expense, on every entry point that uses the one rule parser (regression test for BUG-039)

title: /transactions/parse names an over-cap line
steps: POST /transactions/parse 'cafe 20000000000000\ncafe 45k', then 'cafe 10000000000001' alone
expected: 200 with noAmountLines [1] and one 45.000 ₫ draft; alone: 422 NO_AMOUNT_FOUND
proves: Quick add names the over-cap line instead of previewing it as valid and failing on save (regression test for BUG-033)

title: A 14-digit total balance fits the card at phone width
steps: Account with a -10^13 credit wallet, a 10^13 income and three 10^13 expenses; open / at 390 and 360 px in vi, then in en
expected: '-30.000.000.000.000 ₫' / '-₫30,000,000,000,000' has scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth; each half of the month line has one line box
proves: The total balance is never cut off by the card and the month line never leaves 'thu'/'chi' alone (regression test for BUG-018)

title: Only a credit wallet may start below zero
steps: POST /api/wallets 'Di net' ewallet -999000, cash -1, bank -50000; then a credit wallet at -999000 and 'Di net' ewallet at 0; Wallet.create a bank wallet at -1 directly
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details path initialBalance for the three, nothing saved; 201 for the credit wallet (balance -999000) and the ewallet at 0; the model rejects the direct create
proves: A cash, bank or e-wallet can never start in debt, through the API or any other code that saves a wallet (regression test for BUG-038)

title: PATCH checks the resulting type and opening balance together
steps: Credit wallet at -500000: PATCH {type:'ewallet'}, then {type:'ewallet', initialBalance:0}, then {initialBalance:-1}; default cash wallet PATCH {initialBalance:-10000}; an ewallet stored at -999000 before the fix: PATCH name, the same name/type/balance, archived, then initialBalance -1000, type 'bank', initialBalance 0
expected: 400 initialBalance, 200, 400, 400; for the old row 200, 200, 200, 400, 400, 200 (balance 0)
proves: A patch cannot move a negative balance onto a non-credit wallet, while wallets saved before the rule can still be renamed, archived and fixed (regression test for BUG-038)

title: Wallet dialog marks a negative opening balance on a non-credit wallet
steps: Add wallet 'Di net', type e-wallet, opening '-999.000', Save; then pick 'Thẻ tín dụng' and Save. Edit an e-wallet stored at -999.000 before the rule: rename it and Save; edit it again with opening -500000; edit a credit card at -500.000 and pick e-wallet
expected: The field says 'Chỉ thẻ tín dụng mới được có số dư âm' (en 'Only credit cards can start below zero'), has focus, and nothing is sent; as a credit card it sends POST {type:'credit', initialBalance:-999000}. The rename sends PATCH with the unchanged type and balance; the new negative value and the credit card switched to e-wallet are marked and not sent
proves: The user learns the rule at the field before any request (regression test for BUG-038)

title: Two PATCHes at once cannot leave a non-credit wallet below zero
steps: 10 runs: credit wallet at -500000 gets PATCH {type:'ewallet', initialBalance:0} and PATCH {initialBalance:-100000} at the same time; credit wallet at 0 gets PATCH {initialBalance:-500000} and PATCH {type:'ewallet'} at the same time
expected: After every run each wallet is either credit or at 0 or above; no e-wallet below zero
proves: Each save writes the type and opening balance it checked together, so two tabs saving at once cannot combine into a pair the rule forbids (BUG-038 review finding)

title: Link code comes with one link per chat app
steps: POST /api/chat-links/code with the test settings (TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME, WHATSAPP_NUMBER, ZALO_BOT_URL)
expected: 201 links {telegram: https://t.me/<bot>?start=CODE, whatsapp: https://wa.me/<number>?text=%2Flink%20CODE, zalo: ZALO_BOT_URL}; no telegramDeepLink; the wa.me text decodes to '/link CODE'
proves: Website linking has a one-tap link for each app, and WhatsApp opens with '/link CODE' typed (docs/02 §2.10.2)

title: Missing app settings give null links; the two new settings are validated
steps: POST /api/chat-links/code with TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME, WHATSAPP_NUMBER and ZALO_BOT_URL each unset on its own, then all unset; parseEnv with none, with valid values (a 106-byte ZALO_BOT_URL included), with '+84 901 234 567', '0901-234-567', '0901234567', 'http://zalo.me/123', 'zalo.me/123', 'https:zalo.me/123', 'https:/zalo.me/123', a 107-byte https URL and a 47-character one of 109 bytes
expected: 201 with a code; one unset setting makes only that app's link null, all unset gives links all null; parseEnv accepts none, or an international number without a leading 0 and an https URL of at most 106 bytes, and names WHATSAPP_NUMBER / ZALO_BOT_URL for each bad value
proves: An app the server has no settings for is hidden instead of offering a broken link, and a number wa.me cannot open or a link too long for the card's QR is refused at startup

title: Link card: only configured apps, picker, default app
steps: Generate with links {telegram, zalo}; press Zalo in the picker; generate with all three apps and nothing linked, press WhatsApp; generate with Telegram linked and only telegram and zalo configured; with Telegram and Zalo linked and all three configured; with Telegram and Zalo linked and only those two configured
expected: Picker 'Ứng dụng chat' has Telegram and Zalo only, Telegram pressed, 'Mở Telegram' → t.me link, the QR path equals qrSvgPath(t.me link); after Zalo: 'Chép mã & mở Zalo' → ZALO_BOT_URL in a new tab, its step line, QR of the Zalo link, the code still shown; with all three the picker has Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo and starts on Telegram, and picking WhatsApp keeps focus on the picker and gives 'Mở WhatsApp' → wa.me link with its QR; default Zalo when Telegram is linked and there is no WhatsApp; WhatsApp when Telegram and Zalo are linked; Telegram when every shown app is linked
proves: The card offers each configured app with a matching button and QR, starting where the user still needs to link (docs/02 §2.10.2)

title: Zalo: copy and open, with a fallback when copying fails
steps: Generate with only zalo configured; click 'Chép mã & mở Zalo'; make clipboard.writeText reject and click again
expected: No picker for one app; the button is a link to ZALO_BOT_URL in a new tab, the QR holds ZALO_BOT_URL and the code stays visible; the clipboard holds '/link CODE' and a status region says 'Đã chép /link CODE'; on failure it says 'Không chép được…' and '/link CODE' stays visible and selectable
proves: Zalo linking never dead-ends, even without clipboard access

title: Linked ✓ as soon as the 5 s check finds the new link
steps: Zalo already linked; Generate; advance 5 s; add a Telegram link; advance 5 s; advance 15 s more. Regressions: load /bot with no links, add a Telegram link on the server (another tab), Generate, advance 5 s; and a 3 s code redeemed before it expires (no 5 s check in between), advance 4 s, then 'Tạo mã mới', advance 5 s; and a 3 s code whose link is dated 40 ms after expiresAt (redeemed at the very end), advance 4 s; and 'Linked ✓', then unlink that account; and Telegram linked, a 3 s code expires unused, a Zalo link is added on the server more than 5 s after it expired, unlink Telegram. And: Generate, click a draft's amount field, add a Telegram link on the server, advance 5 s. Held GET /chat-links (answered with the list as it was when it arrived): the page's first list held, a Telegram link added, Generate, release; a 3 s code whose list request is held while it is redeemed and expires; a 3 s code whose last check is held, a link added after it expired, 'Tạo mã mới', release; one 500 on the list after Generate with Telegram linked, then a Zalo link; the first list held, Generate, click 'Mở Telegram', release with Telegram linked; a Zalo link with an empty name
expected: The existing Zalo link is not reported; then 'Đã liên kết ✓ Telegram · Anh Nguyen' replaces the code, with 'Tạo mã mới'; focus, which was on the code, moves to the message; no more GET /chat-links after that. Regressions: the 3 s code shows 'Đã liên kết ✓ Telegram · Anh' after the one last check at expiry, and the next code is not 'Linked ✓'; the link dated just after expiresAt also shows 'Đã liên kết ✓ Telegram · Anh'; after unlinking the account the card drops 'Đã liên kết ✓' and offers 'Tạo mã liên kết'; a link made in another tab gives no 'Đã liên kết ✓', the new code stays, and the card starts on WhatsApp because Telegram is linked (generate always reloads the link list); after the unlink the expired code stays 'Mã đã hết hạn', with no 'Đã liên kết ✓', and focus stays on the Linked accounts heading; with focus in a draft's amount field, the message appears in a status region that was in the card before it (no alert) and focus stays in the field. Held lists: a new list request follows the held one and the card starts on WhatsApp, with no 'Đã liên kết ✓' and the code kept; the last check at expiry still goes out and shows 'Đã liên kết ✓ Telegram · Anh'; the link made after the old code expired is not 'Linked ✓' for XYZ567; after the 500 the card starts on WhatsApp (from the list it had) and later says 'Đã liên kết ✓ Zalo · Lan Zalo'; the opened Telegram stays picked; the empty name reads 'Zalo · zalo' in both places
proves: The user sees the link happen without a reload, and a spent code stops the polling

title: Link card in a real browser: each app's URL, Zalo copy and its fallback, Linked ✓, 360–1280 px, light/dark
steps: New account at 375 px; Generate; read the Telegram link; pick WhatsApp and read its link; pick Zalo, read its link and click 'Chép mã & mở Zalo' (zalo.me answered by a route stub); at 360, 375, 390, 900, 1024, 1100 and 1280 px in light and dark, check the page width and that the picker and QR stay inside the card, and take a screenshot; redeem the code through the Telegram webhook; then, with clipboard.writeText made to reject by an init script, reload, Generate, pick Zalo and click it again
expected: Picker Telegram/WhatsApp/Zalo with Telegram pressed; the links are t.me/<bot>?start=CODE, wa.me/<number>?text=%2Flink%20CODE and ZALO_BOT_URL; a new tab opens at ZALO_BOT_URL and the clipboard holds '/link CODE'; no sideways scroll and the picker wraps inside the card beside the side drawer (900–1100 px); 'Đã liên kết ✓ Telegram · Anh Nguyen' in a status region within 10 s, the code is gone and focus (it was on the Zalo button) is on the message; with copying refused the tab still opens, the card says 'Không chép được…' and shows '/link CODE'
proves: One-tap linking works in Chromium with the real API and clipboard, at phone and desktop width

title: An unlinked chat gets a one-time claim link
steps: Unlinked Telegram and Zalo chats send 'xin chào'; read the reply and linkCodes; send a second message and preview the first token; call createClaimToken 4 times at once for a chat with no row, 10 rounds (each starts with the row deleted), then send 4 messages at the same moment; create linkCodes rows with both and with neither of userId and chat; repeat one message with APP_URL unset
expected: The vi + en 'please link' text plus '<APP_URL>/link?t=<32 base64url characters>' (10 minutes); one row holding the token's SHA-256 and chat {platform, platformUserId, chatId, displayName}, no userId, expiring in 10 minutes, no transaction; after the next message still one row with a new token and the first gets 404 LINK_TOKEN_INVALID; simultaneous messages leave exactly one row per chat; a row with both or neither is refused; without APP_URL no link is sent and nothing is stored
proves: A chat that found the bot first can link without typing, with at most one live claim link per chat, stored as a hash only

title: Website codes and claim links never work in each other's place
steps: An unlinked chat sends /link with a wrong, a used, an expired code and its live claim token; '/link ABC234' while a claim row is stored under the hash of ABC234; then /start with a live website code; then a text from the linked chat
expected: Each bad argument gets the 'invalid code' text plus a new claim link and links nothing; the claim row under ABC234's hash stays unused; the website code links as before (viaClaim false) and makes no claim row; the linked chat gets its usual reply
proves: A claim token cannot be redeemed in a chat, and linking with a code from the chat is unchanged

title: Claim preview and claim; the chat hears that it is linked
steps: Both claim endpoints without login; as a user with language en: preview twice, claim; then preview and claim with the spent token, an unknown one, an expired one and a website code; bodies {}, empty, an object and 101 characters; a claim while Telegram refuses sendMessage; the same flow for a Zalo chat
expected: 401; preview 200 {platform, displayName} both times; claim 201 {id, platform, displayName, createdAt, viaClaim: true}, a chatLinks row for that user with viaClaim true, the token marked used, and the chat gets the /link CODE success text in the user's language through its own adapter; every other token 404 LINK_TOKEN_INVALID and the website code stays unused; bad bodies 400; a refused message still answers 201 and is logged without the token
proves: A claim link works once, within 10 minutes, only for a logged-in user, and the chat is told

title: A chat linked meanwhile answers 409; a token claimed twice at once links once
steps: A claim link for chat X; X is linked to user B with /link CODE; user A claims, then claims again; users A and C claim another fresh token at the same moment; a chat gets a claim link, is linked with /link CODE and unlinked (first by another user, then by its owner), then A previews and claims; the same unlink while A's claim is held between spending the token and writing the chatLinks row
expected: 409 CHAT_ALREADY_LINKED, X stays linked to B only and no message is sent; the retry is 404 (the token was spent); in the race exactly one 201 and one 404, one chatLinks row and one success message; another user's unlink gets 404 and keeps the claim row; after the owner's unlink preview and claim get 404, no chatLinks row, and another chat's claim link still works; the held claim answers 404 with no chatLinks row and no success message
proves: A chat is never linked twice, a token never works twice, and no claim link outlives an unlink

title: /link screen: token handling, confirm with warning, and every state
steps: /link?t=TOKEN logged in (switch vi → en → vi, Confirm) and logged out (log in); Cancel; preview 404; claim 404; claim 409; /link with no token; preview 500 then Retry; a claim that fails on the network, then succeeds; logout with a token waiting; the start-up step on /link?t= and on /bot?t=
expected: The token leaves the address bar before any request and never passes through /login; it is sent only in request bodies; the heading names '<App> · <name>' and '<user> (<email>)' and takes focus; the warning is shown, is not a live alert and describes Confirm; Confirm lands on /bot with 'Linked ✓' and the claim notice; Cancel claims nothing; dead tokens, no token and 409 show their text with 'Go to Bot inbox'; other failures keep the token with Retry / Confirm and translate on a language switch; Confirm, Cancel, a dead token and logout forget the token
proves: The confirm screen shows the phishing warning in every language and the one-time token is not left behind

title: Only claim-made links carry the notice, and only their owner dismisses it
steps: A user links one chat by code and claims another; GET /chat-links; PATCH /chat-links/:id/claim-notice as another user, with an unknown id, without login, with a malformed id, then twice as the owner
expected: viaClaim false/true with claimNoticeDismissedAt null; 404, 404, 401 and 400 change nothing; the owner gets 204 twice and the date is set on that link only
proves: The server side of the 'Not you? [Unlink]' notice

title: Bot inbox 'Not you? [Unlink]' notice
steps: Links: claim-made, claim-made and dismissed, code-made; a 62-character chat name; Dismiss; in a second run Unlink and the dialog; Dismiss answering 500, then 404
expected: Exactly one notice, for the first link, wrapping the long name, as a named group (not a live alert); buttons named with the chat; Dismiss sends PATCH and Unlink asks first, then DELETE; the notice goes and focus moves to the Linked accounts heading; 500 is reported and the notice stays; 404 just reloads the list
proves: A link made from a chat link stays visible and removable until the owner has seen it

title: Linking from the chat in a real browser, and the token stays out of later URLs
steps: POST an unlinked Zalo text to the webhook; open the claim link from the stubbed reply logged out at 375 px; log in; check 360–1280 px light and dark with axe; Confirm by keyboard; Unlink from the notice. Second run, logged in at 360 px with a 62-character name: Cancel, open again, Confirm, Dismiss, reload, open the used link, then a second chat linked with a website code before Confirm
expected: Login returns to /link; the warning is shown; /bot shows 'Linked ✓' and the notice, GET /chat-links says viaClaim true, the chat got the success text, Unlink removes the chat; no later page address, history entry, API URL or Referer holds the token, which appears only in the bodies of preview and claim; no sideways scroll, the snackbar stays on screen with a long name, no serious axe problem; Cancel leaves the token usable; Dismiss survives a reload; the used link and the 409 each show their screen
proves: Linking from the chat works end to end for a logged-out user, with the phishing warning and notice

title: compareRange(): the period one calendar unit before
steps: compareRange({from,to}, unit) on every row of shared/fixtures/compare-range.json: Mon 23–Wed 25/11, 01–25/11, 01–31/10, 01–31/03 and 01–30/03 in a leap and a normal year, a whole February and April, one day, 1/1 to 25/11, 01–07/06/2026 with no unit, with week and with month, a week across the new year, a Tuesday start, a Monday start longer than a week, a range across a month end; then a from after to, 2026-02-30, 25/11/2026 and the unit 'fortnight'
expected: 16–18/11; 01–25/10; 01–30/09; the shorter month's last day caps the range (29/02 or 28/02); dates alone take 01–28/02 for a whole February (→ 01–31/01) and 01–30/04 for a whole April (→ 01–31/03), the gap fill; 01–07/06 → 01–07/05 with no unit and 25–31/05 as a week; with no unit the dates imply day, year, month, week, else the range's own length; every bad input throws RangeError
proves: One calendar rule picks the previous period for the Dashboard and the assistant, so a comparison never reads a wrong or half-missing month

title: The Dashboard's same-days ranges follow the card, and compareRange() agrees where dates are enough
steps: sameDays(month, today) in the browser on every monthCompare row of shared/fixtures/compare-range.json: the current month on the 1st, 25th, 28th/29th/30th/31st (leap and normal February, March, April, November, January), a past month (October, February, leap February, April, January), a month still to come; compareRange(current, 'month') on the server for the same rows; sumDays() over days inside and outside a range; vnToday() and vnThisMonth() with the clock at 2026-11-30T20:00:00Z, 2026-11-30T16:59:59Z and 2026-12-31T18:00:00Z
expected: Current month: days 1..N in both months, N = today's day capped at the last day of the month before (31/03 → 01–28/02 on both sides, 28/02 → 01–28/01, 29/02 leap → 01–29/01, 30/04 → 01–30/03, 30/11 → 01–30/10); any other month whole against the whole month before; compareRange(current, 'month') gives the same previous range on every row except the four marked compareRangeAgrees:false (the last day of the current month when the month before is longer), where it answers the whole month before; sumDays adds only the days inside the range, for the chosen flow; vnToday() is 2026-12-01, 2026-11-30 and 2027-01-01, whatever the machine's time zone
proves: The browser and Express copies of the comparison rule cannot drift apart, the Dashboard never shows more days of last month than of this month, and its idea of today is Vietnam's, not UTC's

title: MonthCompare compares the same days and says "cùng kỳ tháng trước"
steps: MonthCompare on every monthCompare row of shared/fixtures/compare-range.json (including the last day of February, April and November) with a spend of day×1.000 ₫ on every day of both months; the dashboard page with the clock on the 15th and on the 25th and a bill dated the 20th; switch to Thu nhập; the same sentence in English; income only on 29/10 and none in November on 26/11 (Thu nhập, vi and en); spending only on the 20th with today the 5th; the dashboard with the clock at 2026-11-30T20:00:00Z (03:00 on 01/12 in Vietnam), one month back
expected: The sentence reads 'Tháng này chi … , nhiều hơn / ít hơn / bằng cùng kỳ tháng trước …' with the difference of the same-days sums (e.g. 25 days against 25 days, 28 against 28 on 30/03, 30 against 30 on 30/04); 'So với cùng kỳ tháng trước' under the big figure; on the 15th the bill of the 20th is not in the sentence but the highest week is still week 2; the highest week of the whole month stays in the sentence; English says 'the same days last month'; 'Hai tháng này chưa có giao dịch nào' appears only when both whole months are empty, otherwise the sentence says 0 ₫ ('Tháng này thu 0 ₫, bằng cùng kỳ tháng trước.'); after midnight in Vietnam the page opens on December and November is a past month, whole against whole
proves: The Dashboard compares this month so far with the same days of last month, the rule the assistant uses, while the weekly columns still show both whole months
